name: Poterjannye Vospominanija
source:
Missing Memories is a visual novel in the genre of Everyday Life with elements of Psychological Horror and Drama.
The main character named Pavel goes to work, just like ordinary people. On an ordinary day, he has a dream where he sees only a black silhouette under a cliff, and this continues for more than one day. Pavel also can't remember the day she disappeared, and going to a psychologist doesn't help either. The only hope left is hypnosis, but will you be able to restore his Missing Memories and heal his memory?
translation:
《缺失的记忆》是一部日常生活类型的视觉小说，带有心理恐怖和戏剧元素。
主角帕维尔和普通人一样去上班。平日里，他做了一个梦，只看到悬崖下有一个黑色的人影，而且这种情况持续了一天多。帕维尔也不记得她失踪的那天，去看心理学家也无济于事。唯一的希望就是催眠，但你能恢复他缺失的记忆并治愈他的记忆吗？
